title: Welcome to RedMoon
subtitle: Pick a writing style to start. You can change it in Settings anytime

hand.title: Handwriting
hand.desc: Pure local writing with outline, chapters and snapshots. No model needed

assisted.title: AI Assisted
assisted.desc: Write yourself, let AI polish and expand when stuck. One provider is enough

ai.title: Full AI
ai.desc: AI drafts the outline and chapters. Set up providers and embedding models

suggestAssisted: Tip: add 1 official provider (just fill in the Key), add a gateway later if needed.
suggestAi: Tip: add 1 main provider + 1 embedding model (SiliconFlow bge-m3 is the easy choice).
